headline: Ethereum leads TVL at $53.8bn; USDT at $184bn on 4 Oct 2026
summary: Ethereum holds the top position in chains TVL at $53.76bn, followed by Solana and Base. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest DEX volume at $1.43bn in 24h while Tether led fees. USDT and USDC dominate stablecoins with several peg deviations noted. Multiple security incidents occurred in the prior 14 days including large key compromises.
